title: Serialize and Deserialize a Binary Tree
description: Design an algorithm to serialize a binary tree to a string and deserialize it back. Output the string encoding.
input_format: First line contains `n`. Second line contains level-order tokens.
hints: Use BFS or DFS with null markers to encode missing children uniquely.
Join tokens with commas for compact serialization.
Deserialization reconstructs the tree by splitting on commas.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    tokens = data[1:1+n]
    print(','.join(tokens))
else:
    print('')
